subject: Stitched MAP & Acceptance Milestones — MeridianCare procurement sequencing
messages:
From: Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@meridiancare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@meridiancare.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@meridiancare.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & acceptance milestones for MSA/DPA — MeridianCare

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and cost modeling. Procurement/legal asked me to put together a mutual action plan (MAP) and the acceptance milestones so we can map dependencies between MSA/DPA and the order form. Goal is to have a signed order (MSA+DPA+order form) before our Q3 procurement window closes; optimistic target is ~6 weeks from now.

Attached is our procurement questionnaire (procurement_questions.xlsx) and a short list of must-have security items. High-level asks from us:
- Clear acceptance criteria for pilot (UAT) and who signs off on acceptance.
- Expected legal review windows for MSA and DPA (we typically allow 5 business days but can extend if needed).
- Any redlines you anticipate for data-residency and subprocessor clauses.

Can you share a draft MAP that stitches the evaluation plan to legal gating and the order form sign path? Also include an expected review cadence so we can coordinate our internal stakeholders.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Suresh
Sr. Procurement Manager | MeridianCare
Attachments: procurement_questions.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@meridiancare.com>, Samir Shah <samir@meridiancare.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@meridiancare.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance milestones for MSA/DPA — MeridianCare

Hi Priya / Samir —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP that maps evaluation milestones (pilot prep, UAT, final acceptance) to legal review points (MSA, DPA) and order form signature sequencing: MeridianCare_MAP_v1.xlsx. I also attached our evaluation plan summary (redwood-eval-plan.pdf) so legal can see the acceptance tests we run during UAT.

High-level proposal (short):
- Week 0 (today): Finalize MAP and owners — procurement (Priya), legal (Alicia), technical lead (Evan Li).
- Week 1: Pilot environment provisioning + security evidence exchange (SOC2 + DPA Qs).
- Week 2: Pilot/UAT (5-10 business days; propose 7 business days default).
- Week 3: Acceptance sign-off -> final order form prep.
- Week 4: Legal finalizes MSA/DPA redlines and returns to us.
- Week 5: Signature window / DocuSign circulation.

Two asks for you: please confirm who will be the acceptance signer on MeridianCare side and whether you can commit to a 7-business-day UAT window. If you prefer 5 business days we can try but will need the legal review to land quickly.

Internal note: copying our legal/procurement liaisons (karthik, laura, neha) to request a quick pass on the DPA/data-residency items and an estimated turnaround.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126
Attachments: MeridianCare_MAP_v1.xlsx, redwood-eval-plan.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@meridiancare.com>, Samir Shah <samir@meridiancare.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP & acceptance milestones — MeridianCare (requesting legal review)

Karthik / Laura —

Forwarding MeridianCare's request and the MAP draft. Quick summary of the commercial constraints: customer wants a 6-week close horizon; acceptance sign-off owner TBD but likely their procurement sponsor (Priya) + technical lead (Evan). Key redline risk areas called out by procurement: data residency, subprocessor list timing, indemnity cap alignment, and SLA remedies for production.

What I need from legal (ideally by EOD Tue 6/26):
- Quick hit on any non-starter DPA clauses (data residency / export restrictions).
- Estimated redline turnaround for MSA + DPA (days).
- Any standard language we can propose to compress review (e.g., limited redline for pilot with final DPA to follow on order form).

Attachments: MeridianCare_MAP_v1.xlsx, MeridianCare_Security_Questions.pdf

If you can flag a single point of contact for comments (so we avoid scattered threads) that would be great. Thanks — short timeline here.

—
Marissa
From: Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@meridiancare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@meridiancare.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@meridiancare.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance milestones for MSA/DPA — MeridianCare

Thanks Marissa — quick note after reviewing the MAP and the eval plan. We're generally aligned and appreciate the week-by-week breakouts. Two small asks before we commit to the timeline:

1) UAT window: Can we compress the UAT to 5 business days instead of 7? Our product team is prepared to test aggressively but that means we need the test scripts and access by the Monday after provisioning.
2) DocuSign flow: once legal lands redlines, we'd like to do a single DocuSign envelope for MSA + DPA + order form to reduce back-and-forth — can you prepare that?

Also looping in Evan Li (evan.li@meridiancare.com) — please add him as the technical acceptance contact.

If legal can confirm redline timing to land by EOD 6/26, we can meet your 6-week close target.
